title: First Trailer for my first game
author: --Clintoris--
selftext:
Any chance I can get some feedback, what you liked and what you didn't, on a trailer I made for the first game I ever made?

I am new to game dev and definitely new to video editing so any feedback would be appreciated. Thanks!!

comments.author: Former_Limit_6417
comments.body: Honestly, the art looks really nice, but I can't exactly see what the concept is in the game aside from baseball

replies.author: --Clintoris--
replies.body: Great feedback! Thank you I will clean it up

comments.author: ButtlickerNA
comments.body: The foul lines are in the wrong spot

replies.author: --Clintoris--
replies.body: Wow how have I overlooked that this whole time. Thanks I really appreciate it

comments.author: captain_proton
comments.body: So is this kind of like a baseball themed Balatro? I'm working on a football/soccer game that blends a bit of Balatro and Slay The Spire so I'm interested to know how your game works. The cuts are very fast in your video! Are the cards at the top the 'jokers'?

replies.author: --Clintoris--
replies.body:
Yeah exactly, a Balatro/Yahtzee baseball. Every run scored increases multiplier by 1. Thanks for the feedback about the cuts being too fast, I was worried about that. 

And yep! The cards at the are “jokers” but I call them superfans. 

Football/Soccer blend of Balatro and Slay the Spire is really interesting, you getting far along or getting started? I’d be interested in hearing more

replies.author: captain_proton
replies.body:
I’m about halfway through making it now. The main structure is in place, so I’m currently working on balance and progression.

It’s probably more Slay the Spire than Balatro, but the players in your squad are a bit like Jokers. They come in common, uncommon and rare versions, with different roles and stats that affect how your team plays.

In matches, you use cards to build attacks and work your way closer to goal, which improves your chance of scoring. If the other team has the ball, you use defensive cards to hold them off, block shots, pressure them, or try to win possession back. Some actions are only available depending on what part of the pitch you are on.

Then between matches you improve your squad/deck and try to climb through the leagues, of which there are 3, similar to Slay The Spire and its 3 acts. Thanks for asking!

replies.author: --Clintoris--
replies.body: That sounds awesome and a great idea. If you ever need a second set of eyes or a playtester let me know!

replies.author: captain_proton
replies.body:
That sounds like it can lead to some pretty fun crazy scores! I really like the idea of your 'jokers' being superfans, that give you lots of license to get quite creative and give your game a real personality.
From your video it looks like there will be lots of content too.
